paragraphs: R' Shimon ben Mansia, a Tanna, [Chagigah 9a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chagigah.9a.5).

notes.text: The consulted Berakhot explicitly calls the first speaker Rabbi Yehudah bar Mansia. The Mishnah names Rabbi Shimon ben Mansia in the separate discussion of what cannot be put right.
